source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.quote: Athletic Club de Bilbao Kutxabank Financial services
source.note: Shirt-sponsor table row. Same article: 'Kutxabank sponsors the back of Basque clubs Alavés and Real Sociedad, while already being a front-of-shirt sponsor for Basque rival Athletic.'

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.quote: Telecommunications company Digi is also visible as both a front-of-shirt sponsor (Rayo Vallecano and vertical on Racing Santander’s shirtfronts) and a back-of-shirt sponsor (Athletic).
source.note: Back of shirt. The article's sleeve-sponsor table lists no sleeve sponsor for Athletic Club ('Athletic Club de Bilbao – –'), one of five La Liga clubs without one; the article also states 'So far, 15 out of 20 La Liga teams have a sleeve sponsor.'

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.note: Kit-sponsor table row: Castore makes the 2026/27 Athletic Club shirt (kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention).

summary: Kutxabank on the front, Digi on the back, no sleeve sponsor (one of five La Liga clubs without one), Castore as kit maker.
